notes: Cash basis county, governmental funds only. Receipts/disbursements from Statement of Receipts, Disbursements and Changes in Fund Balances (p4), Total Governmental Funds column. Taxes 3,863,797 split into property 3,627,704, motor vehicle 185,633 and lodging 50,460 using the Statement of Activities general receipts (p2); they sum to the printed line. Intergovernmental has no printed breakdown (homestead/tax credit not shown), kept as state aid. Beginning cash = beginning fund balance 4,553,945 (p4); ending 4,336,411. Other financing = Sale of surplus 52,965 (p4). Balance sheet (attempt 3): governmental funds Statement of Assets and Fund Balances (p3), Total Governmental Funds column, since its totals (4,336,411) equal the Statement of Net Position - Cash Basis (p1); fund balance by classification (restricted, committed road maintenance 99,446 and reappraisal 4,485, unassigned 2,976,716; p1's unrestricted 3,080,647 = committed + unassigned). No liabilities. Detail: General Fund recorded from the budgetary comparison schedule (p10) rather than the General Fund combining statement (p5) to avoid double counting; its budget-basis actual receipts (4,537,830) differ from the statement because the budget schedule excludes the Inheritance Tax and Veterans Aid funds and classifies Local/Intergovernmental differently. Road Fund from p11 budget schedule (disbursements printed as one line). Non-major funds: Total Non-Major Funds column of combining statement (p9); 12+ fund columns so combined; the individual fund columns on pp6-9 not recorded. Attempt 4 (verifier fix): non-major 'Local' 275,990 recategorized from other to Ambulance Fees (detail ambulance/rescue fees) because the combining pages show the Ambulance Fund's 143,777 is more than half of it; kept as one printed line with review naming the other funds' parts. Local 773,189 split into charges for services 447,257, interest income 192,725 (category Interest Income) and miscellaneous 133,207 using the Statement of Activities (p2); they sum to the printed line.
